subject: Geopolitics
title: Weaponizing Diaspora Communities
description: A quick, practical guide to Weaponizing Diaspora Communities.

hook.text: China monitors Chinese students abroad through campus groups. Dissent is reported back.

buildup.text: States use diaspora communities for intelligence, influence, and enforcing political conformity far from home.

discovery.text: Turkey tracks Gülen supporters worldwide. Russia monitors dissidents in exile. Iran threatens activists who fled abroad.

twist.text: Most diaspora members are not agents. But suspicion falls on entire communities, creating fear and division from within.

climax.text: Weaponizing diasporas turns immigrant communities into extensions of state power.

punchline.text: Leave the country. The country doesn't leave you.

quiz.question: How do states weaponize diaspora communities?
options: By encouraging all community members to vote in home elections
Through surveillance, intimidation, and enforcing conformity abroad
By providing free legal services to all diaspora members
